authority: Eyes-Project-AI/config/assistive-evaluation.v1.json; Mobile carries a byte-equivalent LF-normalized copy.

latency.timestamp_delta_clock: UTC DateTime; current telemetry is diagnostic until monotonic end-to-end instrumentation is verified

landmarks.first_alert: first measured frame.captured_at -> first alert.emitted_at for that session/window

tts_sample_plan.rationale: 100 pairs give approximately five observations in the upper 5% tail; this is a sampling plan, not a safety confidence bound. Require independent sessions and freeze before final collection.

assistive_segments.design: calibration: 4 classes x 3 bands x 2 lighting x 2 occlusion; evaluation: 24 independent balanced setups; backlit is additional coverage; annotated detection corpus remains separate

denominators.missed_hazard_frame_rate: (expected danger frames predicted distant or missed) / all expected danger frames
denominators.false_alert_frame_rate: distant frames with queued alert / distant frames; diagnostic, not false alerts per minute
denominators.missed_annotated_event_rate: relevant annotated events without alert / relevant annotated events
denominators.false_alerts_per_minute: false annotated alert events / measured minutes
denominators.latency_n: valid paired observations for each metric; never total frames as TTS n

report_requirements.window: explicit operational start and measurement start/end; >=5s and >=30 frames of warmup; no automatic reinterpretation of legacy timestamps
report_requirements.correlation: session_id + correlation_id; exactly one queued alert and at most one matched speech start

remaining: fresh runtime inventory for measured build
independent capture matrix and frozen configuration
